stories.headline: They Have Gone: Wheels Turned at Six Forty, the Hollow Received Them, and the Table Stands Empty Again
body: At six forty-one this morning, the enchanted Jeep backed out of the drive, turned north-northeast, and did not look back. Christine was in the passenger seat with the access-road notes folded twice and committed to memory regardless. Steve had the winch mounted, the recovery rope coiled, and three words ready for whatever the hollow had to say. The duck on the mirror faced forward. It had not moved in six days and it was not about to start.

Sources at the gorge mouth — a waymarker stone, a reliable fox, and one junior Ministry field observer who was technically there on other business — confirmed the Jeep's passage at seven fifty-three. The creek crossing is expected between nine and half past. No further updates have been filed, which is precisely the point.

The table holds nothing. The garage is quiet. Griphook the Younger arrived for his morning briefing, found no one, and stood in the lobby for a full four minutes before accepting that today was simply going to be different. It was, and it will be, until the mud comes home.

stories.headline: Gringotts Runs Smoothly in Her Absence, Which It Attributes to Her, Correctly
body: The bank opened at nine and found itself, to its own quiet astonishment, in reasonable order. Three accounts settled themselves by ten. A long-disputed inheritance briefing resolved without raised voices. A goblin supervisor, asked to explain the unusual calm, stated only that 'the systems hold when they are properly built,' and then stared at the middle distance for a moment in a way that suggested he knew exactly whose systems he was describing.
Christine is expected back Monday. The bank has already set the lobby fireplace to her preferred temperature and pre-loaded two cups on the credenza. No one has admitted doing this.

stories.headline: Governance Transfers Smoothly; Absence of Governing Authority Noted; Absence of Evidence Noted Alongside It
body: With the house to themselves from six forty-one onward, the three familiars have established what observers are cautiously calling 'a working arrangement.' Jersey located the warmest available surface within eleven minutes of the door closing and has not been observed to leave it. Ellie spent forty minutes in conversation with the hall mirror before apparently concluding the negotiation to mutual satisfaction. Lucy has been, by all available measures, entirely still and entirely innocent, which the Domestic Affairs desk considers a Category Two alert.
The biscuit tin has not been audited. This is by design — no one wanted to know.

stories.headline: Ministry Issues Expedition-Day Bulletin; Confirms It Cannot See the Creek From Here; Regards This as Someone Else's Problem
body: The Department of Magical Transportation released a bulletin at eight o'clock this morning acknowledging that the Jeep had crossed beyond observable jurisdiction and that further reporting would depend on 'voluntary post-expedition disclosure.' The Ministry noted it had requested creek-crossing data in triplicate and received, in return, one rubber duck and a hand-drawn contour line. It has filed both.

A junior undersecretary, asked whether the Ministry was concerned about the hollow, confirmed that it had concerns of a general, administrative nature, and that these concerns were indistinguishable from its concerns about most things on a Friday. The bulletin was stamped, logged, and left on a desk to be somebody's Monday problem.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Has maintained a flawless perimeter of innocence since six forty-two and considers this her finest work to date; the biscuit tin is where it was, or near enough that the distinction is philosophical.
Ellie: Reached a satisfactory agreement with the hall mirror around eleven, though the terms are unclear and she appears to have forgotten them already; considers the morning a success.

Jersey: Has not moved from the warm spot by the south window since six fifty-one; has, however, shifted approximately four inches clockwise to account for the movement of the sunlight, which he regards as vigorous activity and is resting from.
founding_editor_note: I built that table with a hand saw and a level — it can hold a full expedition kit and one empty coffee cup and it will never once complain about it. That's construction. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Hollow Creek Crossing Invitational remains unscheduled; entrants are advised to bring a winch.
in_brief.forecast: Clear over the ridge until afternoon; fog in the hollow by dusk; the duck will know before the forecast does.

storyline_updates.title: What the Hollow Gave Back
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: The Jeep departed at six forty-one. The waymarker at the gorge mouth logged their passage at seven fifty-three. The creek crossing was expected between nine and half past. No dispatches have been received from the hollow itself — none were expected. The table is empty. The house is in Lucy's capable and unaccountable hands. Day 2 should be the return: the Jeep comes home with mud, something new marked on the chart, and the one thing from the hollow that nobody expected — the creek crossing result, whatever the ridge gave them, and what the duck looked like when they arrived at the second circle.
